correctness.rationale: The exact capacity follows from a matching partial-decode-forward construction and two elementary cutset bounds. Shiu's common relaxation of the two proposed compress-forward terms extends from BSC(1/4) to arbitrary W1 and W2 with the same channel factorization; conditional post-SDPI then gives the bound 1+eta C2. The BSC wedge and numerical examples follow algebraically and are supported by a finite verification artifact.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Shiu arXiv:2609.18727 states the single BSC(1/4) counterexample but not the arbitrary-channel criterion, BSC two-parameter region, or all-symmetric-BSC continuum. Targeted literature and repository searches did not locate these statements. Established orthogonal-relay capacity and SDPI results are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The recency of the motivating preprint leaves residual near-simultaneous originality risk.

value.rationale: The result converts a single counterexample into a structural sufficient condition and an explicit open family of failures. It explains the separation as a mismatch between the relay-path bottleneck min(C1,C2) and the post-processing contraction eta C2, and supplies a continuum of simple BSC counterexamples.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
